description: This file defines the Smarty_Internal_Debug class, an internal plugin for the Smarty templating engine responsible for collecting and displaying debug information during template rendering. It contains methods for timing different phases (template start/end, compile, render, cache), managing debug data, and displaying the debugging console.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Debug
classes.description: Internal plugin class for debugging Smarty templates, responsible for collecting timing data, managing debug variables, and rendering debug information.

methods.name: start_template
methods.description: Begin timing a template rendering process, increment counters and log start time.

methods.name: end_template
methods.description: End timing a template, update total render time.

methods.name: start_compile
methods.description: Start timing the compilation of a template.

methods.name: end_compile
methods.description: Finish timing the compilation phase and accumulate the time.

methods.name: start_render
methods.description: Begin timing the rendering phase of a template.

methods.name: end_render
methods.description: Finish timing the rendering phase and update cumulative render time.

methods.name: end_cache
methods.description: Finish timing caching operations and accumulate cache time.

methods.name: display_debug
methods.description: Render the Smarty debug console, showing collected debug data.

methods.name: get_debug_vars
methods.description: Recursively collect variables from template/data scopes for debugging.

methods.name: get_key
methods.description: Retrieve or initialize a key for template timing data.

methods.name: ignore
methods.description: Mark a template to be ignored in debug timing.

methods.name: debugUrl
methods.description: Handle URL-based toggling of debugging mode.
